L0524

This multiline HTML fragment is still a plain `String`

What

This multiline HTML fragment is still a plain `String`

Why

Plain String interpolation cannot distinguish trusted HTML fragments from text that must be escaped

Fix

Wrap the literal in `HTML{…}` and type any trusted fragment holes as `HTML`

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning L0524: tests/ui_lint/raw_multiline_html.warn.

Warning [L0524] (raw_multiline_html): This multiline HTML fragment is still a plain `String`
  --> tests/ui_lint/raw_multiline_html.jet:3:13

  3 |     page :: """
    |             ^^^
 Why: Plain String interpolation cannot distinguish trusted HTML fragments from text that must be escaped
 Fix: Wrap the literal in `HTML{…}` and type any trusted fragment holes as `HTML`
